investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Helhollow Software (collaboration SaaS); Platform: on-premises data center DC-West, server range 172.25.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster helhol-prod (kubeadm); Istio service mesh (mTLS STRICT); workload certificates are signed by istiod with an intermediate CA certificate that cert-manager obtains from a Vault PKI issuer; Change management: production changes carry CR- identifiers.
